subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Phase: The Hidden Dimension
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Phase: The Hidden Dimension.

hook.text: Two sine waves with the same frequency can cancel each other — if their phases are opposite.

buildup.text: Phase measures where in its cycle a wave starts — 0° is the peak, 180° is the trough.

discovery.text: Noise-canceling headphones flip the phase of ambient sound — destructive interference silences it.

twist.text: In multi-antenna systems, phase alignment steers radio beams without moving the antenna.

climax.text: Beamforming in 5G and Wi-Fi 6 uses phase control to aim signals at your device.

punchline.text: Same frequency, different phase — waves can add up or cancel out entirely.

quiz.question: How do noise-canceling headphones work?
options: They block sound with thick padding
They generate an inverted phase copy of ambient noise for destructive interference
They amplify music to drown out background noise
